pacing: Greyson usually naps 1–2 hours starting between 11 AM and 1 PM. Keep the stroller available; do not plan around waking him for a ride.
Use a “watch first, ride second” strategy for new rides and loud attractions.

Adult-only rides require Rider Switch; Indiana Jones requires 46 in., and Haunted Mansion/Pirates may be frightening even though they have no height limit.
Rain might cancel outdoor entertainment and close attractions. Have a rain cover, layers and a sheltered alternative.

These are group allowances, not measured navigation times.
days.skipFirst: Skip castle photos, extended shopping, then a long Pirates/Jungle queue before sacrificing Cars Land, the droid build or Naples. Pirates is dark/loud with small drops; an adult can stay with Greyson if he’s uncomfortable.
extraNotes: Budget approximately $119.99 + tax for one droid; accessories cost extra. Edward or Danielle should be the registered builder; the building area permits the builder plus two guests, and only the builder assembles the droid. Greyson can watch, pick colors, and try the remote.

Plan ~50 minutes at Droid Depot, but walk-in waits may exceed this. Keep a firm 2:45 PM departure goal. If Pirates has >25 minutes posted standby or Jungle Cruise runs late, skip the extra ride, not the droid stuff or 4 PM dinner.
